messages:
ana: quick triage: newmodel 'sparrow-lite-q4' on synth-holdout shows NDCG +1.8% but MRR -2.3% vs fp16. opening thread to capture ideas.

kevin: can you paste the eval flags and which dataset variant? we have synth_v3 (with html noise) and synth_v3_clean.

ana: eval was: ./bench --model sparrow-lite-q4 --holdout synth_v3 --seed 11 --strip_html false --append_context_meta true

li: aha. synth_v3 has a lot of engineered negatives and appended source tags like [src:docstore]. short queries in that set are very sensitive to one extra token.

sam: any stratified numbers? length/meta breakdown?

ana: quick split: short(<=6)+meta: MRR -4.0%, NDCG +0.6%. long+meta: MRR +0.9%, NDCG +2.4%. clean dataset (no meta) is flat.

kevin: consistent pattern. Two hypotheses: 1) quant shifts logits near boundary so extra meta token flips top1 for short queries, 2) dataset selection (synth_v3) has sampling that magnifies ndcg.

li: try three things: strip meta only for short queries, run fp16 vs q4 token-level parity check, and compute top1 flip counts by group.

eval-bot: job 4076543225 started: sparrow-lite-q4/strip-meta-short

ana: ran strip-meta-short: short+meta MRR now -0.5%, long+meta unchanged. top1 flips concentrated in short+meta: 210/1000 flips -> 28/1000 after strip.

sam: good. for dataset side, what's the negative sampling strategy? if synth_v3 negatives are harder, ndcg might rise even with top1 loss.

ana: synth_v3 used dense hard negatives from a transformer retrieval model; that increases ndcg sensitivity. MRR down because exact top1 ordering changed on short queries.

kevin: practical fix: onboarding doc should require (a) run short/long x meta stratification, (b) compare flip counts not just aggregate NDCG/MRR, (c) ablate appended meta.

li: also consider tiny post-quant calibration: affine scale/bias on logits for reranker head. sometimes preserves NDCG gains and reduces top1 flips. but targeted postprocess (strip meta short) is lower risk.

eval-bot: job 4076543275 completed: sparrow-lite-q4/strip-meta-short artifacts -> s3://redwood-evals/4076543275

ana: will add checklist entries and a unit test: synthetic short queries with meta injected should not exceed 1% MRR regression vs fp16.

sam: please add a note: dataset authors - avoid appending provenance as tokens for short-query heavy benchmarks; prefer separate metadata fields to be ignored during scoring.

kevin: agreed. also add a script to compute flips_by_group and include in bringup CSV.

ana: filing PR for checklist + tests + canary rule. thanks all :clap:
